robot_path: Use existing ROS CAN driver as single command owner; do not construct a second SDK robot
gripper_measurement_notes: At each stationary opening, independently measure inner-face spacing with caliper/ruler before the next target. Do not change homing/zero or mechanical configuration.
TCP_steps: One physical grip-centre base XYZ at current pose to estimate offset, then two independent base XYZ observations at the holdout poses; return to original qpos after each pose. Pose movement targets must be checked against fresh feedback and free space before execution.
response_test: J1 only, +/-0.01 rad, five-second small sine test; log goal/feedback sensor stamps at command and observed update rates. Existing historical tests remain separate.
must_recheck_before_start: gripper is empty; fingers and arm sweep clear
no active trajectory or another motion sender
gate is closed initially and restored afterwards
user_instruction: 只读检查，沿用旧参数，暂不做新的运动测量
